mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the PermMatrix constraint allows non-allowed role-operation pairs to be claimed as valid, which the LeastPrivilege assertion checks directly.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_PermissionViolation { Applicant -> PatchApplicationsStatus in PermMatrix.allowed }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing append-only enforcement allows duplicate audit entries for the same transition, which the assertions explicitly forbid.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_DuplicateAuditEntry { some disj ae1, ae2: AuditEntry | ae1.application = ae2.application and ae1.previous_status = ae2.previous_status and ae1.new_status = ae2.new_status and ae1 != ae2 }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the no-self-decision constraint allows officers to decide their own applications, violating the conflict-of-interest rule.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_SelfDecision { some ae: AuditEntry | Officer in ae.actor.roles and ae.previous_status != none and ae.actor = ae.application.applicant }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the in-flight constraint allows an applicant to have multiple pending or under-review applications simultaneously.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_MultipleInFlight { some disj app1, app2: LoanApplication | app1.applicant = app2.applicant and app1.status in (Pending + UnderReview) and app2.status in (Pending + UnderReview) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows any officer to patch an application they are not assigned to, violating ownership-based access control.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_UnauthorizedPatch { some ae: AuditEntry | ae.previous_status != none and ae.actor != ae.application.assigned_officer }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing audit completeness allows applications to change status without corresponding audit entries, breaking the audit invariant.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_MissingAudit { some app: LoanApplication | no ae: AuditEntry | ae.application = app and ae.new_status = app.status }
